prose.description: Shem is a sandy oasis near the middle of the continent, bordered by Skinner's Roam, the Border Zone, Venge, and the Swamp. Few people live there: Nomads keep a small village with an animal shop, and Grayflayer smugglers run a bar with beds upstairs. No faction collects taxes on its flat ground, but Dust Bandits, starving bandit mobs, Beak Things, and blood spiders roam it.
